holdings.name: Rubicon Research Ltd.

what_changed.text: The US FDA inspected the Satara manufacturing plant from October 5 to October 9, 2026, issuing a Form 483 with one procedural observation.
Quarterly sales reached Rs 534 crore and net profit rose to Rs 85 crore for the June 2026 period.

holdings.why_it_matters: Rubicon Research is the fund's largest position at 3.84%. Although it gained 60.28% over 6 months, a 15.10% decline over the past month creates drag across the fund's 13.5% healthcare allocation.

watch.text: Monitor the company's regulatory communication and remediation steps regarding the single procedural observation at Satara.

holdings.name: VA Tech Wabag Ltd

what_changed.text: The company won a repeat medium order from Reliance Industries for an effluent treatment plant at Jamnagar with a 13-month execution schedule.
Operating margin fell to 9% on sales of Rs 887 crore and net profit of Rs 90 crore in the June 2026 quarter.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 3.82% weight, the stock fell 11.52% over 3 months, contributing an estimated -0.440% to fund returns and ranking as the second-largest quarterly detractor.

watch.text: Track project milestone progress for the Jamnagar effluent treatment plant over its 13-month timeline.

holdings.name: CCL Products (India) Ltd

what_changed.text: Second-quarter net profit grew 29% year-on-year to Rs 130 crore on revenue of Rs 1,211 crore.
The stock dropped 9% in a single trading session following the Q2 earnings release.
Company Secretary Sridevi Dasari resigned effective November 14, 2026, with Kallepally Bharath Kumar appointed from November 15, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 3.49% portfolio weight, CCL Products fell 17.84% over 3 months, dragging performance by an estimated -0.623% as the fund's biggest single detractor.

watch.text: Observe price stabilization and post-earnings reception following the sharp sell-off to 7-month lows.

holdings.name: Aditya Infotech Ltd.

what_changed.text: The company completed a Qualified Institutional Placement on September 25, 2026, issuing 43.27 lakh shares at Rs 3,467 each to raise approximately Rs 1,500 crore.
Revenue reached Rs 1,402 crore with a net profit of Rs 142 crore in the quarter ended June 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Carrying a 3.38% weight in the portfolio, its 12.45% 3-month return generated an estimated +0.421% contribution, reinforcing the fund's 10.8% technology exposure.

watch.text: Monitor deployment timelines and allocation of the Rs 1,500 crore raised through the QIP.

holdings.name: Karur Vysya Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: The bank lifted its FY27 margin outlook post-Q2 results while shares reached new all-time highs.
Ramshankar R took over as Chief Operating Officer on October 16, 2026, succeeding Chandrasekaran M S.

expected.text: Management guided for 18% to 20% credit growth in FY27, maintaining a 20% cap on corporate lending.

holdings.why_it_matters: Karur Vysya Bank's 3.02% weight delivered an estimated +0.693% contribution over 3 months, bolstered by a 22.94% quarterly gain.

watch.text: Track deposit funding cost pressures against the upgraded FY27 margin guidance.

holdings.name: Dr. Agarwal’S Health Care Ltd.

what_changed.text: The NCLT sanctioned the amalgamation with Dr. Agarwals Eye Hospital, establishing an effective date of November 1, 2026, and a share exchange record date of November 18, 2026.
June 2026 sales came in at Rs 614 crore with net profit of Rs 55 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: Representing 2.92% of the fund, the holding posted a 3.38% drop over 3 months, moderating performance within the fund's 13.5% healthcare allocation.

watch.text: Follow completion of the 23:2 share exchange ratio post the November 18, 2026 record date.

holdings.name: Sky Gold Ltd

what_changed.text: The company completed the 100% acquisition of Purvi Gems & Jewellery on October 7, 2026, for Rs 9 crore.
June 2026 revenue rose to Rs 2,013 crore with net profit increasing to Rs 105 crore.
Doshi Jain & Co. was appointed internal auditor on October 16, 2026, following the exit of Aasna Shah.

holdings.why_it_matters: Sky Gold was the top quarterly contributor, adding an estimated +1.443% as its 2.57% weight surged 56.16% over 3 months.

watch.text: Monitor operational integration and revenue contributions from Purvi Gems & Jewellery.

holdings.name: Syrma SGS Technology Ltd

what_changed.text: Syrma Johari MedTech inaugurated an over 120,000 sq. ft. facility in Jodhpur focused on medical plastics and precision molding.
The company signed a partnership with Essencore to expand domestic manufacturing in India.
The stock was included for trading in the F&O segment effective October 28, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding 2.52% of fund assets, Syrma gained 15.42% over 3 months despite a 10.49% 1-month correction, supporting technology holdings.

watch.text: Track production ramp-up at the Jodhpur MedTech facility and execution progress on the Essencore partnership.

holdings.name: Rainbow Childrens Medicare Ltd

what_changed.text: Executed a 60-year lease agreement for 2 acres in Amaravati to construct a 250-bed pediatric and perinatal hospital.
Appointed Sudarshan Patodia as Chief Financial Officer on September 23, 2026.
ICRA reaffirmed its credit rating at [ICRA] AA (Stable) on September 29, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 2.36% portfolio weight, the stock declined 17.17% over 3 months, resulting in an estimated -0.405% drag on fund performance.

watch.text: Follow capital expenditure outlay and development timelines for the new Amaravati hospital project.

holdings.name: Campus Activewear Ltd

what_changed.text: Unveiled a redesigned retail store format in New Delhi on October 1, 2026.
Conducted an Analyst Day in New Delhi on October 9, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 2.20% portfolio weight, its 11.44% quarterly drop detracted an estimated -0.252% within the fund's 25.3% consumer discretionary segment.

watch.text: Monitor customer response and retail rollout traction from the reimagined store strategy.

portfolio.statement: Motilal Oswal Small Cap Fund delivered a modest 0.42% 3-month return as sharp gains in Sky Gold and Karur Vysya Bank were offset by deep drawdowns in CCL Products and VA Tech Wabag.
interp: Concentrated winners like Sky Gold (+56.16%) and Karur Vysya Bank (+22.94%) provided sufficient upside to keep quarterly performance positive.
Corrections across major holdings such as CCL Products (-17.84%) and Rainbow Childrens (-17.17%) created a substantial drag on fund returns.
portfolio.line: Outsized gains in select discretionary and banking holdings counterbalanced steep sell-offs in staples and utilities.

drivers.text: Sky Gold generated an estimated +1.443% contribution supported by a 56.16% 3-month return, strong earnings, and the Purvi Gems acquisition.
Karur Vysya Bank added an estimated +0.693% following a 22.94% gain driven by raised FY27 margin outlooks and strong credit targets.
CCL Products reduced returns by an estimated -0.623% after the stock tumbled 17.84% over 3 months following its Q2 earnings release.
VA Tech Wabag detracted an estimated -0.440% amid an 11.52% 3-month drop and compressed June quarter margins.

themes.title: Bifurcated Consumer Discretionary
themes.text: The fund's largest sector exposure (25.3%) saw divergence between high-growth jewelry manufacturing and lagging footwear retail.

themes.title: Domestic Technology & Manufacturing
themes.text: Technology holdings (10.8%) expanded manufacturing capacity and capital through QIP issuances and new facility additions.

themes.title: Healthcare Capacity and Corporate Restructuring
themes.text: Healthcare holdings (13.5%) pursued physical expansion and corporate amalgamations despite recent market-price corrections.

macro.factor: Regional Bank Credit Expansion vs Funding Costs
macro.why: Karur Vysya Bank targets 18-20% credit growth for FY27 while navigating deposit funding cost risks to protect margins.
Government push and corporate investments in domestic manufacturing are driving facility build-outs and assembly partnerships.

priced_in.text: Aditya Infotech's valuation reflects successful equity dilution after raising Rs 1,500 crore through its institutional placement.
Karur Vysya Bank's lifetime highs price in the upper band of its 18% to 20% FY27 credit growth target.
Sky Gold's 3-fold surge in FY27 captures optimism around the Purvi Gems takeover and rapid top-line growth.

could_change.title: Deposit Cost Inflation
could_change.text: Intensified deposit competition could strain net interest margins at Karur Vysya Bank below upgraded targets.

could_change.title: Regulatory Clearance Bottlenecks
could_change.text: Any procedural complications stemming from Rubicon Research's Satara Form 483 observation could affect product launch schedules.

portfolio.risk_note: With a top 10 holding concentration of 30.1% and a historical maximum drawdown of -23.69%, quarterly performance remains susceptible to sharp earnings-related drops in mid-sized allocations.
